{{Top|leg}}
'''Ithorian SkyYards''' was an [[Ithorian Herdship]] manufacturer located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]].

This single producer of the [[Sky Yards-class Herdship|''Sky Yards''-class herdships]] was presumably wiped out when the planet of Ithor was destroyed by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].
